request: 10,000 additional zones throughout existing world plus 10 new relaxing liminal levels, 2,500 zones each. Deliver and refine one level at a time.
counting: Zones in the new levels are combinatorial architectural recipes, not 2,500 handmade models. A recipe counts only after distinct structural mesh fingerprints are verified with the same seed/coordinates. Placed objects, recolours and repeated instances are not new models or extra zones.
